Each example is one query against one published dataset. Every reader that
answers it has its own tab, and the page records who ran each reader,
where, when, and what came back, so equal answers across readers are on
record.

## Adding an example

Copy `docs/examples/_template/` to `docs/examples/<slug>/` and fill in:

- front matter: `title`, `description`, `date` (last run), `categories`
  (dataset family, forms, languages);
- the **Query** block: dataset, selection, and the expected result
  (shape, first and last values);
- one tab per reader: code that runs as pasted, plus a status line
  `[ok]`, `[no]` or `[not run]` with who, where and when;
- the **Runs** table.

Code on these pages is not executed when the site is built (no data access
in CI); the values shown are pasted from real runs.
